School and Youth Group Residentials - Brathay Trust Home Come to Brathay School and Youth Group Residentials
School & Youth Group Residentials
For Long Lasting Impact
Young people today are tackling new challenges and being held to high standards. At Brathay there’s just one thing for them to do – have an adventure!
As the pioneers of outdoor education, a residential or day programme at Brathay is like no other. We inspire and empower young people to fully engage with their experiences, helping them to lead their own learning — because we know the most impactful lessons are the ones they create themselves.
We're lucky to be in the heart of the Lake District National Park, at the Brathay Hall estate. It offers excellent access to fells, lakes and plenty of space for on-site adventure
Get in Touch
We work with all youth organisations for a brighter future :
Primary School Residentials
Packed with imaginative learning and adventure.
Secondary School Residentials
Providing young people with challenge by choice.
College & Sixth Form Residentials
Empowering the next generation to shape a brighter future.
Youth Group Residentials
Exploring leadership and wellbeing to create a brighter future for young people and their community.
Our Approach
We know no two people are the same, and that goes for young people too. Our fully qualified facilitators are exceptional and able to adapt and respond to make sure that every young person has a memorable time with us. They know how to step back, just enough to let the young people take the reins, helping them discover their potential.
We offer experiences they won’t find at school or home that build life skills such as:
Critical thinking
Problem-solving
Emotional intelligence
Confidence
Team-working
We'd love to discuss how we can create a memorable residential for your young people.
Get In Touch
Looking for funding?
We believe that financial barriers should not stop young people from benefiting from a life-changing residential experience.
If you need help with funding your residential , we've created a handy, up-to-date guide to funding options available across the UK to help you find the right support for your school or youth group.
The Brathay Bursary
We also offer our own financial support through the Brathay Bursary, a discretionary fund designed to help schools and youth groups with the cost of attending an outdoor residential at our Lake District centre.
If you're interested in applying, simply mention the Brathay Bursary when you enquire. Our friendly team will be happy to discuss and guide you through the next steps.
Get In Touch
Every young person deserves a life-changing residential experience. Let's break financial barriers and make it possible for all.

Our History - Brathay Trust Home About Our History
Our History
Celebrating 80 years of supporting young people
As pioneers of the outdoor education movement Brathay has been at the forefront of young people’s development for 80 years.
Established in 1946 by Francis C. Scott, the charity is dedicated to improving the life chances of young people. With a rich history of empowering young people through experiential learning and community support, Brathay Trust continues to impact lives positively, fostering resilience and unlocking potential in young people from across the UK.
In the last 80 years, we’ve had the privilege of meeting so many remarkable people at Brathay. Their journeys didn’t end when they left, in many ways, they were just beginning. We love hearing how their experiences here helped them grow, and we think you will too.
Explore Alumni Stories
Were you ever part of a Brathay programme?
Whether it was years ago or more recently, we’re inviting Brathay alumni to share how Brathay played a role in their journey.
Join the My Brathay Story alumni community.
Share your story
In 1946, Francis C. Scott had a vision to provide new opportunities for young people. 80 years later, we're still passionately committed to giving the best support and change lives.

Holiday Accommodation - Brathay Trust Home Come to Brathay Holiday Accommodation
What a stunning location!
We had the best weekend at Brathay. The room was spacious and the view was breathtaking. There is lots of areas of to walk and explore close-by. All the staff were so polite and helpful, noting all our requests before we arrived.
Super happy with our stay at Brathay. Honestly, we smiled the entire time. Would definitely stay at Brathay again!
Brathay Holiday Maker
Escape to the Brathay estate
In The heart of the Lake District
If you’re dreaming of a getaway, Brathay is your perfect escape! Tucked away in a stunning private estate in the heart of the Lake District, Brathay promises a serene retreat like no other.
Imagine waking up to stunning views of the Lakeland fells and Windermere. With nature at your doorstep and easy lakeside access, your stay is sure to be unforgettable.
We are a pleasurable 15 minute walk to Ambleside and Waterhead, and less than 3 miles from the stunning Langdale Valley. Whether you’re up for adventure or a peaceful escape, we’re the ideal base. Plus, enjoy the convenience of free on-site parking with EV charging points and hassle-free check-in from the moment you arrive.
Book Now
En-Suite Rooms Choose from our cosy en-suite rooms, available in standard and superior, ideal for couples or individuals, friends or families. Whether you need a double, twin, or family room, we’ve got the space for you.
Superior Scafell Lodges
Large, light, and spacious luxurious rooms overlooking the estate. Features include a comfy king-sized bed or twin beds, spacious en-suite, lounge area, and TV.
Brathay Hall Standard Rooms
Located in or near the main hall, these rooms feature a comfy king-sized bed or twin singles, en-suite, TV, and hot drinks facilities. Lake-side views are available for an additional cost.
Single En-Suites
Ideal for solo travellers, these huts are located in a quiet wooded area near the main hall. Features include standard-sized single beds, en-suite shower, TV, hot drinks facilities, dedicated parking with EV charging points.
Book Now
Self-Catering Properties Prefer the freedom of self-catering? Our characterful properties are an excellent choice. With mostly bunk-style rooms, they are perfect for larger groups ready to explore the sites of the Lake District.
Jiffy Knotts (Sleeps 2 to 4)
Two-story Victorian mid-terrace, with two double rooms.
Cosy living room, fully-fitted kitchen, downstairs bathroom and utility room.
South-facing garden with local woodland walks and river trails.
Hestead House (Sleeps 9)
Two-story cottage with an en-suite twin room, 4-bed bunk room, single room and a second twin room with accessible wet room.
Family bathroom upstairs.
Also includes a fully fitted kitchen-diner and a large lounge with TV.
Lingmoor (Sleeps 20)
Overlooking the River Brathay, this building accommodates up to 20 people with four bunk-style dormitories and two twin bedrooms.
Includes a small fitted kitchen, large lounge/group room with dining space, comfy sofas, games, and TV.
For larger groups, combine with Old Brathay to sleep up to 59 people across two buildings, with access to a kitchen and dining space for up to 70 people.
Shackleton Lodge (Sleeps 32)
Situated in its own woodland setting with dedicated parking and outdoor space.
Accommodates up to 32 people in bunk-style dormitories.
Features a fully fitted kitchen and dining block nearby, built-in BBQ, large lounge area, refreshment station, TV, two shower/toilet blocks, and an accessible toilet/shower room.
Old Brathay (Sleeps 39)
Our largest property, a grand house overlooking the River Brathay, accommodates up to 39 people in bunk-style dormitories and one accessible single room with accessible wet room and toilet.
Features three lounge areas with TVs, comfy seating and games, a dry room, and a small kitchenette for refreshments.
Dedicated parking.
Little Brathay attached is a large kitchen/dining room for up to 70 people and is included in the hire of Old Brathay.
For larger groups, add Lingmoor to sleep up to 59 people across two buildings.
Book Now
Campervan and Caravan Pitches Looking for a simple base to explore the Lake District? Pitch up your campervan or caravan at one of our electric hook-ups. A peaceful setting surrounded by fells, walking routes and outdoor adventures. With Ambleside just a mile away, you'll be perfectly placed to discover all that the area has to offer. Please note that washing and toilet facilities are not provided.
£20 per night

Read More
Welcome, We Are
Brathay Trust
Since 1946 Brathay has been inspiring young people to build their own brighter futures. We work with young people from across the UK, from their school years through to their early careers .
As many will testify from their own experience, Brathay’s distinctiveness comes from several sources – it is more than just the place, the people, and its values. While all the dimensions of Brathay’s distinctiveness may be hard to name completely, those that stand out are:
History
Purpose
Ethos and Values
People
Place
Approach
Brathay is a special place, and the young people we support could go on to become our leaders, innovators, and change-makers of the future. Their resilience and skill will help shape our future society.
Teresa Jennings, Chief Executive
We deliver experiential residential programmes to young people from across the UK at our dedicated centre in the heart of the Lake District, in addition to working within community settings in Bradford and Cumbria . This blended approach of residentials and community-based programmes is unique to Brathay.
Our Impact
Brathay supports over 7,000 young people each year, inspiring growth and positive change that lasts a lifetime. With our robust evaluation framework, we can see just how impactful our programmes are, making sure we keep delivering the best support and lasting benefits.
